adjudication.rationale: In `admin-group.js.es6`, the new `addMembers` action calls `this.get("model").addMembers(this.get("usernames"))` but never resets `usernames` afterward; the code even includes `// TODO: should clear the input`. This means the UI will retain the previously-added usernames, so clicking “Add” again will resend the same list. The diff does not prove the exact server-side failure mode (e.g., a 500 on duplicates), but the stale input/resubmission behavior is directly verifiable from the change.
